newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India awards Hazira NGL tender to Vitol at -$43/T.
newsitem.headline: India awards Hazira NGL tender to Vitol at -$43/T.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) sold by tender 25,000 tonnes of natural gas liquids (NGL) for July 24-26 lifting from Hazira to Dutch trader Vitol at around $43 per tonne below Japanese spot naphtha quotes, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender offering the west coast cargo on a free-on-board (fob) basis, closed on July 17 and was valid for one day.
IOC's last NGL tender, for a cargo lifting July 12-14 from Hazira, was also awarded to Vitol at $37.00 per tonne below Japanese spot naphtha quotes, fob.
IOC has offered another NGL cargo from Hazira for July 31-August 2 lifting, in a tender closing July 24 and will be valid for a day.
